entity: Illinois state hazardous-waste inspectors' 15.5% write-up rate at sites where EPA found violations, vs other states
why: EPA OIG (2026) reports the same kind of finding in general - EPA finds violations in 76% of its inspections vs states' 52% - but names no state and uses per-inspection rates, not our same-site paired measure. Investigate Midwest names Illinois EPA but for a different finding (notices falling over time). Nothing states Illinois's paired rate.
